notes.title: New Update: Exciting New Pieces, Music, and More in Marbleous!
notes.notes:
In the newest Marbleous! update, we're giving you even more tools to build incredible tracks and enhance your racing experience.


New Horizontal Track Pieces: Unlock five brand new horizontal pieces to create even more dynamic and challenging circuits for your marbles.
New Funnel Piece: Add a thrilling funnel element to your tracks, this new piece have two funnels to join in a one path.
Epic Music for Race Mode: Pump up the action with a brand new, high-energy epic track that will get your marbles racing!
Relaxing Music for Build Mode: Take your time and enjoy a calm, lo-fi new tune as you craft the perfect course for your marbles.
Bug Fixes: We've polished up the gameplay with various bug fixes for a smoother experience.


The Marbleous! track-building system continues to evolve, giving you more creative freedom to design, race, and share tracks with friends. Whether you're in the heat of a race or designing the perfect challenge, this update makes it all the more exciting. Ready to race? The podium awaits!
